sources.title: AWS Builders Library — Making retries safe with idempotent APIs
sources.finding: A timeout can leave the caller unsure whether a mutating operation happened; blind retry can duplicate side effects; reconciliation or a service-level idempotent contract is required. Client request identity must have semantic meaning and server recording/mutation must be atomic.

sources.title: ExoFlow: A Universal Workflow System for Exactly-Once DAGs (OSDI 2023)
sources.finding: Recovery semantics can be decoupled from execution and selected as a separate layer; exactly-once recovery has workload-specific tradeoffs.

sources.title: Automated Verification of Idempotence for Stateful Serverless Applications / Flux (OSDI 2023)
sources.finding: Retry-based fault tolerance depends on idempotence; stateful functions can violate it, motivating executable verification rather than assumption.

sources.title: Conformant Planning via Heuristic Forward Search
sources.finding: Belief space can be represented as sets of possible worlds and actions can be required to succeed across all worlds.

sources.title: Beliefs In Multiagent Planning: From One Agent to Many (ICAPS 2015)
sources.finding: Partially observable planning commonly models belief as a set of states regarded as possible; observations/actions prune or transform that set.

sources.title: Structured Possibilistic Planning Using Decision Diagrams (AAAI 2014)
sources.finding: Finite qualitative belief spaces can support planning under partial observability without requiring precise probabilities.

counterevidence: Possible-world/belief-state planning is established prior art.
Idempotency/reconciliation and exactly-once workflow recovery are established systems techniques.
A provider-specific state machine can encode the same decision tree and may be faster.
